verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own overview lists collective scheduling as a supported mode alongside round-robin [cal-com-docs-28]. The slots API can return times when two or more people are all available [cal-com-docs-38], and team availability is queryable [cal-com-docs-12], with team event scheduling configuration varying by scheduling type [cal-com-docs-35]. The core is supported, but the evidence is thin, so quality is moderate. Missing for 10: explicit docs on collective event setup and on the rule that slots appear only when all required hosts are free; any detail on required versus optional hosts; independent or hands-on corroboration.
